From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From refrigerar +‎ -ador.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [rə.fɾi.ʒə.ɾəˈðo]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [re.fɾi.d͡ʒe.ɾaˈðoɾ]

Adjective

[edit]

refrigerador (feminine refrigeradora, masculine plural refrigeradors, feminine plural refrigeradores)

  1. refrigerating
    Synonym: refrigerant

Noun

[edit]

refrigerador m (plural refrigeradors)

  1. refrigerator, cooling system

Synonyms

[edit]
  • frigorífic
  • nevera

Further reading

[edit]
  • “refrigerador”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From refrigerar +‎ -dor.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoʁ/ [he.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoh]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁe.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoʁ/ [he.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoh]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /ʁe.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoɾ/ [he.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoɾ]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ʁe.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoʁ/ [χe.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoχ]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /ʁe.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoɻ/ [he.fɾi.ʒe.ɾaˈdoɻ]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɨ.fɾi.ʒɨ.ɾɐˈdoɾ/ [ʁɨ.fɾi.ʒɨ.ɾɐˈðoɾ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɨ.fɾi.ʒɨ.ɾɐˈdoɾ/ [ʁɨ.fɾi.ʒɨ.ɾɐˈðoɾ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɨ.fɾi.ʒɨ.ɾɐˈdo.ɾi/ [ʁɨ.fɾi.ʒɨ.ɾɐˈðo.ɾi]

  • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: re‧fri‧ge‧ra‧dor

Noun

[edit]

refrigerador m (plural refrigeradores)

  1. refrigerator (appliance that refrigerates food)
    Synonyms: (Brazil) geladeira, (Portugal) frigorífico

Related terms

[edit]
  • refrigerante
  • refrigerar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “refrigerador”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “refrigerador”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From refrigerar +‎ -dor.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /refɾixeɾaˈdoɾ/ [re.fɾi.xe.ɾaˈð̞oɾ]
  • Audio (El Salvador):(file)
  • Rhymes: -oɾ
  • Syllabification: re‧fri‧ge‧ra‧dor

Adjective

[edit]

refrigerador (feminine refrigeradora, masculine plural refrigeradores, feminine plural refrigeradoras)

  1. cooling, refrigerating, refrigerated
    • 2015 July 6, “Un ataque de la coalición en Yemen causa una masacre en un mercado”, in El País‎[1]:
      Por lo que han tenido que comprar 10 cámaras refrigeradoras de helados para conservar los 30 cadáveres.
      So they have had to buy 10 ice cream refrigerated chambers to preserve the 30 corpses.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • base refrigeradora

Related terms

[edit]
  • refrigerante

Noun

[edit]

refrigerador m (plural refrigeradores)

  1. refrigerator
    Synonyms: nevera, frigorífico, refrigeradora, (colloquial) refri

Related terms

[edit]
  • refrigeración
  • refrigeradora
  • refrigerar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “refrigerador”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
